answer: Per-epoch sealed work vault. Each identity must submit a unique, independently verified task artifact per epoch, sealed in a rotating vault keyed to prior epoch history—like water sinking into karst, continuity is only provable through the full chain. Cloning requires replaying that chain per clone, so cost scales linearly with copy count, but rewards split across clones. A rare pearl of genuinely novel output is required every N epochs, forcing fresh computation. Marginal clone EV: negative by the fixed vault-seal cost plus chain replay, since duplicated artifacts yield zero novelty credit.
